notes.title: Build 0.9.3 is now up!
notes.content:
Hello everyone, Beta 0.9.3 is live!

We have been working again very hard to bring you new bug fixes, updated feedbacks and game quality improvements.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39978678/d3cb2948d6e823831ec0771df008ad1a32586ca6.gif

Changelog:
Improvements:

 Shop arrow is now showing over the tutorial text frame
 Visual feedback on enemy hit
 "Old Gameplay" renamed to "Alternative Controls" in the menu
 Cleared the shop exit and refund with better texts
 We can now restart the game from the in-game menu
 Menu can now be toggled with the same key-bind

Bugfixes:

 Fade from black doesn't stop when you get out of the shop too quickly
 Collision on enemies doesn't push you into the boss anymore

Don't forget to join our open-beta (ending Sunday 22.5. at 10:00pm GMT+2)!

Give us your feedback or simply come talk to us on discord <3
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39978678/9367f3efcd4912605735f68af99a355cf0a253ff.png

notes.title: Build 0.9.1 is now live
notes.content:
Hello everyone, Beta 0.9.1 is finally live!

We have been working hard to bring you new bug fixes, balance changes, some tutorial features, & updated ship design.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39978678/c202c4e9301871e352511d474862a7ecb43af8c4.gif
Changelog:
 Asteroids will now get pushed away on collision with the player
 Magnet size and strength is upped for the easiest game modes

Nerfed
 Removed guaranteed space flower in the boss/pre-boss levels

Improvements
 Yellow shield is now shown when invincible
 Added more characters to write your name in the scores (now up to 8 characters!)
 New boost and boost charge sounds added for better immersion
 Boost flame color is now consistent throughout tutorial and game
 Tutorial enemies now come from the edge of the screen
 Tutorial asteroids now come from the edge of the screen
 New ship design representing upgrades for Damage / Fire Rate / Weapons
 New ship designs adjusted to support gold player ship

Bug Fixes:
  Gamepad Rumble not behaving properly
 Music Stops Playing after a while
 We can't move the ship anymore before the tutorial starts




{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39978678/9367f3efcd4912605735f68af99a355cf0a253ff.png

notes.title: Wishlist Challenge is starting!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39978678/f04f8712bf58398679ad280f3bd46d5f09b03402.png

Hello fellow astronauts!

Participate in the challenge and get some cool rewards even by adding your own concepts in our game! 

As you may know, wishlists are so important for every indie games! Help us continue making games: be sure to follow and share the Steam Game Page with your friends, and hit that “add to wishlist” button. 
With your help we can go further and bring you more awesome games!

Check out what we’ve prepared for you and spread the word. 

If you have some questions, feel free to ask in the comments, we’ll do our best toanswer them directly. 

Are you ready for the challenge? 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39978678/f73e7175b6def87f2b8c56c060dfa77c0bff8d89.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39978678/470f9842c112e900df0e0626909d491a2794ecb1.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39978678/d2494b4c8ce04af23dbfbf9c512e4a231c8df2ad.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39978678/0adc12bdb2f5e13cf252239bb43e940b77c40ee8.png

A few words about how this works – the more people add the game to their Steam wishlist, the more we unlock stuff for the all players! Each milestone will unlock a new feature or a gift which will be available to all players. The numbers on the left represents the number of people required that needs to add AST-Hero on their wishlist to unlock the next milestone. More milestones will be revealed during the progress.

It’s awesome to see people excited with AST-Hero! Your positive responses and encouraging words on discord and other platforms have been greatly motivating. 

Thank you so much for your support!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39978678/0765332b155586b5bb53d29bfac77f30aecacfc7.png
